title: Closed Areas Regulation, Schedule 1, section 8 (Reidemann)

source.version: BC Laws consolidation current to October 13, 2026

source_text:
Schedule 1 No Shooting, Hunting or Trapping Areas (Section 2)
Reidemann
8 That portion of the Province, in the vicinity of Alkali Lake, Lillooet Land District, that is within the following boundaries: All of Alkali Lake below the mean high water mark.
